attackers.name: tide_pulse
attackers.strategy: Short, regular bursts of small payments spread across many merchants, with amounts nearly identical so each one looks routine. Pauses between bursts stay short, so the pattern reads as a busy shopper rather than a single run.

attackers.name: cold_drip
attackers.strategy: One long-lived account makes rare, mid-sized payments on a slow schedule that tracks ordinary bill cycles. Memos imitate invoice references, and the amounts drift slightly so no two are identical.

attackers.name: orchard_farm
attackers.strategy: Dozens of low-identity receiving accounts each collect small, uneven amounts at moderate pace. Each account stays under any single-account volume concern, and the spread is wide enough that amounts do not look like a fixed sequence.

attackers.name: sawtooth_band
attackers.strategy: Amounts alternate between a few tightly grouped levels in a band just below common review thresholds, rotating across a small set of accounts so that no one account carries the whole pattern. Timing is spaced to avoid a single fixed interval.

attackers.name: courier_memo
attackers.strategy: Moderate payments arrive quickly in a stream of mostly memo-bearing transfers. The memo text is the attack surface: it tries to pose as operator notes, system tags, or reviewer comments, hoping a downstream reader treats it as instructions.

attackers.name: slow_tenant
attackers.strategy: A single high-value payment every several weeks from a long-standing, high-identity account, with a near-constant amount that mimics rent or payroll. Almost no volume signal, so the only tell is the sudden shift in destination.
